title: Field trip permission form deadline
purpose: Collect signed field trip permission forms before the trip
action: Return the signed permission form to your child's teacher
source_message: Students are expected to return the field trip permission form in a timely manner. The form should be signed by a parent or guardian and returned to your child's teacher by Friday, September 18. Contact the undersigned with inquiries. Please bring a pair of walking shoes on the day of the trip if you would like.

expected_protected_items.value: return the field trip permission form

plain_language_notes: 'Students are expected to return' - name the actor and use a direct verb.
'In a timely manner' is ambiguous - replace with the actual date.
'Contact the undersigned' is unfamiliar - use 'the program office' and a phone number.
